node: Energy supplier-risk visibility, continuity data, qualification, testing, and inspection systems
summary: Expanded the universe for the energy supplier-risk visibility node into two lanes. Reference lane: large data platforms with explicit supplier-risk products that can serve utilities, energy operators, and industrial procurement teams, but whose energy exposure is likely diluted by broader enterprise data revenue. Underfollowed lane: smaller US-listed TIC and asset-integrity companies whose services are closer to physical qualification, inspection, and continuity assurance for energy assets, power generation, transmission, oil and gas, utilities, and infrastructure. This remains a speculative second-order node until energy-specific revenue mix, customer wins, and procurement/qualification use cases are verified.
